intro.title: Valid Palindrome
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that checks if a given string is a valid palindrome. A palindrome is a word, phrase, or sequence that reads the same forward and backward, ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization. You will learn to use string manipulation techniques and the two-pointer algorithm to efficiently compare characters from both ends of the string. The main technologies involved are JavaScript strings, loops, and conditional logic. This exercise will help you practice algorithmic thinking and problem-solving with simple data structures.
intro.usecase: The palindrome check is a foundational string validation pattern used in real-world software for data sanitization and user input verification. For example, in content management systems, it helps detect and prevent the submission of spammy or nonsensical text in comment forms or user profiles. It's also applied in search and filter features, such as in admin dashboards that flag or highlight suspicious entries, and in game development for puzzle mechanics that require symmetrical input. Mastering this algorithm equips developers to implement robust validation logic critical for maintaining data integrity across web applications.
